title: Experience Pure Joy: Wake UP and Play

segments.x: everybody wake up wake up it's time to play everybody wake up wake up it's a brand new day i want you to think about yourself as a child before anything bad had ever happened to you and you only know goodness you only know love you only know joy you're laughing you're playing and i want you to experience yourself as a kid receiving as much love as possible
at this point in your life you don't know any pain any misery no bitterness only joy only love and you can see yourself in your mind laughing from having such a good time playing outside

editorial.summary: A one-minute official-channel guided visualization. A wake-up/play/new-day refrain leads into an invitation to imagine oneself as a child before harm, knowing only goodness, love and joy, laughing and playing outside while receiving abundant love. The final instruction is simply to feel that image. Every word remains, but the scene is explicitly optional and imagined: many listeners do not have a pain-free childhood point, and the source does not establish a recovered memory, universal developmental truth, trauma treatment or David Choe biography. It is cataloged as a performed visualization rather than factual testimony. No caption turn is publisher-labeled; zero named turns ship.
